mrd.text: Slobad is a goblin tinkerer born under the Eye of Doom, a taboo meaning death, and hidden by his mother in the air ducts, until Dwugget finds him and raises him in the Krark Cult.
After the Leonin capture him and he flees a failed invention, he helps the captured elf Glissa free herself and leads her to Taj-Nar to be healed, and he repairs the golem Bosh, who joins them.
The group learns Memnarch is responsible for the attacks, but Memnarch takes control of the Kaldra avatar and betrays them, and Bosh gives his life so his friends can escape.

Memnarch captures Slobad and tortures him, and when Glissa knocks herself and Memnarch into the core, her spark transfers to Slobad, who meets Karn and gives up the spark to resurrect the dead and send them home.

dst.text: Slobad is remembered by Glissa as seemingly exiled for being too smart, and he builds the Ascension Web for Memnarch.
Meanwhile Glissa escapes pursuers with a burst of green fire, the sapient wolf Al-Hayat joins the group and helps rescue Slobad, and Glissa and Slobad survive the blast.

5dn.text: Slobad journeys with Glissa and Bosh to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch, who seizes it with a single spell and turns it on them.
Glissa and Slobad flee and are captured by Viridian elves, but in the green lacuna Malil stabs Glissa and Slobad is taken, and Memnarch has him mutilated and takes over his torture.
Slobad finishes a plane-wide network for spark transference while his own mind begins to reassert itself, and when everyone dies, the souls, mana and Glissa's spark enter him and he ascends.
Karn tells Slobad that saving his friends would cost both of them the spark, and Slobad agrees.
